title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett (Adapted)
description: A story of discovery, friendship, and the magic of nature.

chapters.title: Mary Arrives

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When Mary Lennox was sent to Misselthwaite Manor to live with her uncle, nobody knew what to do with her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She was a thin, sallow child with a sour expression, and she had never cared about anyone in her life.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: I don't like this place. It's too big and too quiet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The housekeeper, Mrs. Medlock, showed her to a room in a long corridor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The manor was filled with hundreds of rooms, most of them locked and forgotten.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: Why are all the doors locked? What are they hiding?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That night, Mary heard a strange sound echoing through the dark hallways.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It sounded like someone crying, far away.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: What was that? Is someone there?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mrs. Medlock appeared suddenly in the doorway.

lines.speaker: player2
lines.text: It's just the wind, child. Now go to sleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Mary knew it wasn't the wind. Something mysterious was happening in this house.

artifact.caption: Mary stands before the vast, mysterious Misselthwaite Manor

chapters.reflectionPrompt: What do you think Mary will discover in the manor?

chapters.title: The Garden Door

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The next morning, Mary explored the grounds around the manor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A friendly robin appeared and hopped along beside her, as if leading her somewhere.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: Hello, little bird. Do you know this place better than I do?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The robin chirped and flew toward a wall covered in thick ivy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hidden beneath the leaves, Mary saw something glinting in the sunlight.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: A key! But what does it open?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She followed the wall until she found a door, almost completely hidden by ivy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The door had been locked for ten years, ever since her uncle's wife died.

lines.speaker: player2
lines.text: No one's been in there since the accident. Best leave it be.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Mary's curiosity was stronger than any warning.

lines.speaker: player1
lines.text: I have to see what's inside. Just once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She turned the key. The lock clicked. The door creaked open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before her lay a forgotten garden, wild and overgrown, waiting to be brought back to life.

artifact.caption: The hidden garden door, covered in ivy, revealing its secrets

chapters.reflectionPrompt: If you found a secret garden, what would you do with it?
